### Added

- *(tenants)* Credential refs name only tenant credentials in [#1068](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1068) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- The Google access-token credential provider runs beside Substrate in [#1046](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1046) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Changed

- *(deps)* Update gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/agent-manager docker tag to v2.3.1 in [#1001](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1001) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(connectivity)* Drop the portal's dead rootRedirect and nav-item:agent-platform in [#1070](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1070) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Fixed

- *(tests)* Retry a throttled registry with backoff honouring Retry-After in [#1073](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1073) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v4.140.0...v4.141.0


### Release-candidate proof (v4.141.0-rc.5)

agentlab v0.110.2, a local kind test installation with `tenants.organizations.enabled`. agent-platform 4.140.0 upgraded in place to `4.141.0-rc.5`. It moves no Substrate or kagent range (Substrate 1.12.0, kagent 1.13.0 before and after).

- **All releases:** 15 of 15 HelmReleases Ready on 4.141.0-rc.5.
- **[#1046](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1046):** `google-access-token-credential-provider` 0.1.0 Ready in `ate-system`, after `substrate`; Deployment 1/1, Service :50051 and its CiliumNetworkPolicy in place. It loads its namespace policy and admits only `spiffe://cluster.local/ns/ate-system/sa/atenet-egress`. Nothing is routed to it in this release.
- **[#1001](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1001):** the agent-manager migration Job ran on `agent-manager:2.3.1`; agent-manager is Ready.
- **[#1070](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1070):** the portal's app-config carries no `rootRedirect` and no `nav-item:agent-platform`; `/` answers 200 with the Agent Platform shell.
- **[#1068](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1068):** proven on rc.1 (in [#1068](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1068)); `agentlab tenants-test` passes again here.
- **[#1073](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1073):** test code only.
- `agentlab platform-test`: 13 PASS, 0 FAIL. `agentlab tenants-test`: 6 PASS, 0 FAIL.
